en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3878 - It is narrated from Al-Hasan bin Ali Al-Washsha' who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (as) about a man who purchased a specified number of plots of land from another man for one hundred kurr, with the condition that he would give him the payment from the yield of the land.
Imam (as) said: "This is forbidden."

I said: "May I be your ransom, what if he purchases the land with a specified measure and with wheat from elsewhere?"
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that."
